$comment: The ten elements, verbatim from the GDD section 5.1. SAFETY RULE, non-negotiable: nothing here is real chemistry - no real names, no real symbols, no real combinations, and the game must never function as a lookup for how to combine or break down real substances. Every symbol is exactly three letters, because real element symbols are one or two; the format is what stops the table being mistaken for the periodic table, and build-content.mjs rejects any symbol that is not three letters. There is deliberately no atomic number, row or column here: canon gives an element a symbol and a domain and nothing else, and a grid with numbered cells is exactly the shape the safety rule exists to avoid. Canon expects this table to grow to roughly 20-24 once the power set is decided.
